name: Hidaka (Saitama, Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Hidaka city emblem in white: a stylised bird-like device with a pointed tail enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Hidaka, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 30 November 1970.

features.role: Hidaka city emblem — a stylised bird-like device with a pointed tail enclosing a disc
